title: Handley Page Halifax LV955
memorial_details: description: Rectangular, stained-glass panel in an oak frame, located bottom-right of an older, plain, two-light window.  The panel depicts a Halifax bomber flying against a sunlit sky. The 192 Squadron badge and motto are above and below the aircraft.  Two brass plaques provide the dedication and the crew names, engraved in black, upper-case letters.
